problems.title: Question 1: Sum of Array Elements
problems.description:
Fix the logical and syntax errors in the given C program so that it reads an integer N followed by
N space-separated integers, and prints their total sum.

problems.title: Question 2: Count Even and Odd Numbers
problems.description:
Read an integer N followed by N integers. Print the count of even numbers and odd numbers
separated by a single space.

problems.title: Question 3: Reverse a Number (Debugging)
problems.description:
Debug the program below so that it reverses the digits of a given positive integer N and prints
the reversed number.

problems.title: Question 4: Prime Number Range Count
problems.description:
Given two positive integers L and R (1 <= L <= R <= 1000), count how many prime numbers exist
between L and R inclusive.

problems.title: Question 5: Matrix Row Maximums (Debugging)
problems.description:
Fix the bugs in the C code so it reads an R x C integer matrix and prints the maximum element of
each row separated by spaces.

problems.title: Question 6: Second Largest Unique Element
problems.description:
Read an integer N (2 <= N <= 100) followed by N integers. Print the second largest distinct
element in the array. If all elements are equal, print -1.
